metadata.source: O*NET Web Services API v2 + WEF Future of Jobs Report 2025

skills.name: Critical Thinking
skills.rationale: Essential for evaluating AI outputs, identifying biases, and solving novel problems that large language models struggle with.
skills.short_rationale: Essential for evaluating AI outputs and solving novel problems.

skills.name: Complex Problem Solving
skills.rationale: AI excels at narrow tasks but struggles with highly interconnected, ambiguous, or multi-stakeholder problems.
skills.short_rationale: AI struggles with ambiguous, multi-stakeholder problems.

skills.name: Systems Thinking & Systems Analysis
skills.rationale: Critical for designing and managing AI agent ecosystems, supply chains, and socio-technical systems.
skills.short_rationale: Critical for managing AI agent ecosystems and socio-technical systems.

skills.name: Active Learning
skills.rationale: 39% of core skills will transform by 2030 (WEF). Rapid learning is the meta-skill for staying relevant.
skills.short_rationale: 39% of core skills will transform by 2030. Rapid learning is essential.

skills.name: Technology Design & Programming
skills.rationale: Building, fine-tuning, and orchestrating AI systems remains a high-value human capability.
skills.short_rationale: Building and orchestrating AI systems remains high-value.

skills.name: Judgment and Decision Making
skills.rationale: AI provides recommendations, but final accountability, ethical trade-offs, and high-stakes decisions remain human responsibilities.
skills.short_rationale: Humans retain accountability for ethical and high-stakes decisions.

skills.name: Coordination & Collaboration
skills.rationale: Human-AI teaming, cross-functional leadership, and stakeholder alignment are difficult to automate.
skills.short_rationale: Human-AI teaming and stakeholder alignment are hard to automate.

skills.name: Environmental & Sustainability Analysis
skills.rationale: The green transition is a major WEF driver through 2030. Skills in environmental systems and sustainable design are seeing structural demand growth.
skills.short_rationale: Green transition is a major structural driver through 2030.

skills.name: AI Literacy & Human-AI Collaboration
skills.rationale: The ability to effectively direct, evaluate, and integrate AI tools into workflows is becoming a baseline requirement.
skills.short_rationale: Directing and integrating AI tools into workflows is becoming baseline.

skills.name: Creativity & Originality
skills.rationale: While AI can generate content, true novelty, cultural resonance, and breakthrough innovation remain distinctly human strengths.
skills.short_rationale: True novelty and cultural resonance remain human strengths.

skills.name: Emotional Intelligence & Social Perceptiveness
skills.rationale: Empathy, negotiation, leadership, and reading subtle social cues are core to management, healthcare, and education roles.
skills.short_rationale: Empathy and leadership are core to management and care roles.

skills.name: Resilience & Adaptability
skills.rationale: Constant technological and economic disruption requires psychological resilience and flexibility.
skills.short_rationale: Constant disruption requires psychological resilience.

skills.name: Data Literacy & Statistical Reasoning
skills.rationale: Interpreting AI-generated insights, understanding uncertainty, and making data-informed decisions.
skills.short_rationale: Interpreting AI-generated insights and making data-informed decisions.

skills.name: Cybersecurity Awareness & Risk Assessment
skills.rationale: As AI systems expand attack surfaces, human oversight of security and ethical risk becomes increasingly critical.
skills.short_rationale: Human oversight of security and ethical risk is critical.

skills.name: Ethical Reasoning & Responsible AI
skills.rationale: AI deployment raises new ethical, bias, fairness, and governance challenges that require human judgment.
skills.short_rationale: AI raises new ethical and governance challenges requiring human judgment.

skills.name: Leadership & Influence
skills.rationale: Inspiring teams, navigating organizational change, and aligning diverse stakeholders in AI-transformed organizations.
skills.short_rationale: Inspiring teams and aligning stakeholders in AI-transformed organizations.

skills.name: Scientific Reasoning & Research Skills
skills.rationale: Designing experiments, interpreting results, and advancing knowledge in AI, biotech, and climate science.
skills.short_rationale: Advancing knowledge in AI, biotech, and climate fields.

skills.name: Project & Workflow Orchestration
skills.rationale: Managing hybrid human-AI workflows and orchestrating complex projects across humans and AI.
skills.short_rationale: Managing hybrid human-AI workflows and complex projects.

skills.name: Routine Data Entry & Administrative Processing
skills.rationale: AI agents and RPA systems can already perform these tasks faster and more accurately.
skills.short_rationale: AI agents and RPA can perform these tasks faster and more accurately.

skills.name: Basic Content Generation (Reports, Summaries)
skills.rationale: Large language models now generate first drafts of reports, marketing copy, and documentation at scale.
skills.short_rationale: LLMs generate first drafts of reports and documentation at scale.

skills.name: Simple Customer Service & Query Handling
skills.rationale: AI chatbots and voice agents handle increasing volumes of routine support.
skills.short_rationale: AI chatbots handle increasing volumes of routine support.

skills.name: Basic Code Generation & Maintenance
skills.rationale: AI coding assistants now generate and debug boilerplate and standard patterns.
skills.short_rationale: AI coding assistants generate and debug boilerplate code.

skills.name: Manual Quality Inspection (Visual/Repetitive)
skills.rationale: Computer vision and robotics are rapidly replacing human inspection on assembly lines.
skills.short_rationale: Computer vision and robotics are replacing human inspection.

related_occupations.title: Inspectors, Testers, Sorters, Samplers, and Weighers

skills.name: Basic Data Analysis & Reporting
skills.rationale: AI tools now automatically generate dashboards, trend reports, and basic insights.
skills.short_rationale: AI tools now automatically generate dashboards and basic insights.

skills.name: Routine Scheduling & Coordination
skills.rationale: AI agents manage calendars, book meetings, and handle logistics with minimal human input.
skills.short_rationale: AI agents manage calendars and logistics with minimal input.

related_occupations.title: Executive Secretaries and Executive Administrative Assistants

skills.name: Basic Translation & Language Processing
skills.rationale: Neural machine translation has reached near-human quality for many language pairs.
skills.short_rationale: Neural machine translation has reached near-human quality.

skills.name: Repetitive Physical Tasks (Manufacturing & Logistics)
skills.rationale: Advances in robotics and cobots continue to displace repetitive manual labor.
skills.short_rationale: Robotics and cobots continue to displace repetitive manual labor.

related_occupations.title: Laborers and Freight, Stock, and Material Movers, Hand

skills.name: Basic Financial Transaction Processing
skills.rationale: AI-powered accounting systems and blockchain reduce the need for manual transaction handling.
skills.short_rationale: AI accounting systems and blockchain reduce manual transaction handling.
